$comment: Classroom overrides, kept apart from the district calendar. Each entry: date (YYYY-MM-DD), optional until (last day, inclusive), type, groups ("all" or ["odd"] / ["even"]), note, and added (the date you enter it; required). An override never changes a class dated before its added date, so past lessons and journal numbers stay as they were. Types: closure = no class (with groups "all" it also shifts the pacing guide, like a snow day); noJournal = class meets but no journal (assembly, testing); journal = assign a specific journal id to that class (journal: "j05"). releases: optional teacher-approved unit opening times in Central Time, e.g. {"3": "2026-09-18T15:30"}; otherwise a unit opens at the calendar releaseTime on its first class day. Example override: {"date": "2027-02-03", "type": "closure", "groups": "all", "note": "Snow day", "added": "2027-02-03"}
